public.title: Missing Number
public.description: The array values contains n distinct integers drawn from 0 through n inclusive. Exactly one integer from that range is missing. Return it. The array may be unsorted and n is between 0 and 1000. Aim for linear time and constant extra space.
hints: Compare the expected sum of the full range with the actual sum.
public.attribution: Original statement, examples, tests and solutions authored for Bekor, 2026. Uses a standard algorithmic pattern; no third-party exercise text used.

explanation: The sum from 0 through n is n times (n + 1) divided by 2. Subtracting the input sum leaves the missing value. All intermediate sums are safe integers under the constraints. Time is O(n), extra space O(1).
